page.overview:
Who is Rafela Cindal?

Rafela Cindal (pronounced: rah-FELL-ah sin-DAHL) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is tall and plump and of a dark complexion. She has a round face that is normally mild and pleasant, but could be serious or even stern. Her voice is normally sweet.

Rafela is a strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of .

Merana Ambrey feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, even though she is its appointed leader. Rafela, Faeldrin Harella and Masuri Sokawa are the three strongest sisters in the group. She is strong enough to Travel.
